" All over the world, theyre admitting it. Other countries are failing, and failing badly. But I say, why is it that no matter how well youre doing, we seem, not a president, Democrat or Republican, almost never wins the midterms. Weve gotta change that, because we have something going thats so good, we cant let that string be broken.

Trump: So Im asking you to pretend that Im on the ballot. Im on the ballot. Im on the ballot. Just one more time, because if we lose, youre going to lose your border, youre going to lose your tax cuts, youre going to lose your safety and security, youre going to lose your wealth. Our country is going through hell.

Trump: You will be going through hell just like you did just two years ago. We went through hell. We were a laughingstock all over the world. We were laughing, they dont laugh at us anymore, do they? They dont laugh. But thats what would happen. The pundits, the fake news media and the radical left communists will say anything they can to try and stop us. But in this election, all that matters is that we are united, we are together, and what we say counts."
